fields.why: The report names itself a summary of genomic surveillance, but it also compares the updated (NREVSS-weighted, biweekly) estimator with the previous one and concludes they are consistent, which matches 'evaluation of a surveillance system, indicator or nowcast'. Adding evaluation is defensible; it is a secondary component.

The multinomial nowcast has no stated covariates beyond time, so the literal rule 'true also when the model itself has no covariates' gives true; but there is no exposure-outcome contrast, so false is equally defensible. The brief should say unadjusted/adjusted are null or false for a trend/nowcast model with no contrast of interest.

brief_issues: regression_fields for descriptive nowcast/trend models (no exposure contrast): unadjusted_results undefined.
